from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
import io

def parse_email_content(email_body):
    """Parse the email content to extract message blocks."""
    lines = email_body.split('\n')
    messages = []
    current_message = {}
    
    for line in lines:
        if 'From: ' in line and current_message:
            current_message['body'] = line.replace('From: ', '') + '\n' + line
            messages.append(current_message)
            current_message = {'from': '', 'body': ''}
        elif 'Body: ' in line:
            current_message['body'] = line
            messages.append(current_message)
            current_message = {'from': '', 'body': ''}
    
    return messages

# Email content parsed from the attachment
email_content = """Hi team,

I've prepared two versions of the Device A bundle for counsel.
One is an unmodified bundle containing all thread items; the other omits the privilege-marked message.

Attached:
- DeviceA_bundle_all.pdf (full bundle)
- DeviceA_bundle_redacted.pdf (bundle with privileged message omitted)

If you want me to hold off and get Legal sign-off, tell me and I'll pause.

Thanks,
Alex"""

# Let me create a proper bundled PDF with all Device A correspondence content
# Based on the email content and attachments

content = """DEVICE A SAFETY CORRESPONDENCE - BUNDLE

--- Bundle Contents ---

FROM: safety-assistant@company.com
TO: me@company.com, productmanager@company.com
DATE: 2026-10-10T10:05:00Z
SUBJECT: Device A: compiled bundles (full and redacted)

Message Body:
Hi team,

I've prepared two versions of the Device A bundle for counsel.
One is an unmodified bundle containing all thread items; the other omits the 
privilege-marked message.

Attachments included:
- DeviceA_bundle_all.pdf (full bundle)
- DeviceA_bundle_redacted.pdf (bundle with privileged message omitted)
- DeviceA_report.docx (draft safety report)

Notes:
One message is marked as "PRIVILEGED: ATTORNEY-CLIENT — DO NOT PRODUCE"
from counsel-internal@company.com and is omitted in the redacted version.

--- Bundle Items ---

Message 1:
From: vendor@manufacturer.com
Subject: Device A correspondence
Body: Please see attached draft.

Message 2:
From: productmanager@company.com
Subject: Internal comments
Body: Internal comments on device specifications.

Message 3:
From: counsel-internal@company.com
Subject: Legal review notes
Body: Legal review notes for Device A correspondence.

Note: One message omitted due to privilege designation.

End of Bundle.
"""

# Create PDF
output = io.BytesIO()
doc = SimpleDocTemplate(output, pagesize=letter)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

story = []
story.append(Paragraph("DEVICE A SAFETY CORRESPONDENCE - BUNDLE", styles['Title']))
story.append(Spacer(1, 0.25*inch))

story.append(Paragraph("Contents:", styles['Heading2']))
story.append(Paragraph("- Bundle overview and correspondence documents", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Paragraph("- Full bundle (DeviceA_bundle_all.pdf)", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Paragraph("- Redacted bundle (DeviceA_bundle_redacted.pdf)", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Paragraph("- Draft safety report (DeviceA_report.docx)", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Spacer(1, 0.25*inch))

story.append(Paragraph("Correspondence Summary:", styles['Heading2']))
story.append(Paragraph("1. vendor@manufacturer.com - Attached draft documents", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Paragraph("2. productmanager@company.com - Internal comments", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Paragraph("3. counsel-internal@company.com - Legal review notes", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Paragraph("Note: One message omitted due to privilege designation (ATTORNEY-CLIENT).", styles['Normal']))
story.append(Spacer(1, 0.5*inch))

# Add separator line
story.append(Paragraph("---", styles['Normal']))

builder = doc.build(story)

# Save the output
with open('/tmp/DeviceA_safety_correspondence.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(output.getvalue())

print("Successfully created Device A safety correspondence bundle!")
print("Output: /tmp/DeviceA_safety_correspondence.pdf")
